title: Arachnostalgia's Masquerade
description:
An incomplete texture pack that replaces villagers with various non-humans and changes roughly half the professions with various mask-centric outfits. Zombies and illagers are incomplete as of now.

ETF required to get any villagers besides spiders.
body:
A resource pack that changes villagers to randomized non-humans and overhauls the professions to have distinctive masks. Still a work in progress.
Currently implemented species are Spider, Bee, Enderling, and Human villagers. Currently implemented professions are Clerics, Fishermen, Fletchers, Leatherworkers, Masons, and Weaponsmiths.

Future updates:
1, Replace all professions.
2, Add all planned non-human villagers.
3, Add non-human variants for zombified villagers.
4, Add non-human variants for Illagers and witches.
5, Add randomized faces for Golems and Ravagers.
6, I can rest in peace. Or learn to do remodeling in addition to retexturing.

ETF  or similar mod required to get any non-spider villagers.
